open_issues: Finding 1 was fixed by removing the keydown modifiers entirely rather than by the prescribed render-time `_suppressDefault` flag. Blazor evaluates `@onkeydown:preventDefault` at RENDER time, so a flag set inside the handler only takes effect on the NEXT keystroke: after any ArrowDown the flag would still be true when Tab arrives, and the tree would stay a focus trap. Trade-off accepted and commented in the code: arrow keys now also let the browser scroll the nearest scrollable ancestor. If that scrolling ever becomes visible on A05, the fix is a max-height on the tree pane so the tree itself is the scroll container (arrow scrolling then follows the active row), not a preventDefault.

The drag handle is still inert (no draggable attribute, no drag events). The cursor and the gallery sub-title no longer advertise a gesture that does not exist, but real drag-to-reparent remains unimplemented and is out of scope for this package.

Twelve msedgewebview2 processes are running on this machine. They were started AFTER my host was killed (01:14 vs my 01:11 launch) and belong to the concurrent b2-screens host, so I left them alone. My Wakeel.Desktop process is gone and port 9335 is confirmed closed.

FIX PER FINDING

1. Keyboard trap / dead Ctrl+F (medium) — `@onkeydown:stopPropagation` and `@onkeydown:preventDefault` both removed from the `<ul role="tree">`; the listener is now plain `@onkeydown="HandleKeyDown"`. See open_issues for why the prescribed `_suppressDefault` flag was not used (render-time evaluation lags one keystroke and would keep Tab trapped after any arrow key). Verified over CDP: focus `ul.w-tree`, two ArrowDowns (active descendant moved), then Tab -> `document.activeElement` became `BUTTON.w-kpi w-kpi--action`. The window keydown listener behind `wakeelUi.bindCtrlF` is now reachable from inside the tree.

2. Bidi-broken search highlight (medium) — added `SnapToTokenBounds`, which tokenises the name with the same run definition as `Bidi.Wrap` (maximal-munch over `[A-Za-z0-9./\_:@+,- ]`, trimmed back to the last alphanumeric) and widens the match bounds outward to the run they land in, so the highlight can never cut a Latin/numeric token in half. Verified in the host: searching «Arch» now yields DOM `<mark>` text `‏⁦Archive⁩` — exactly one U+2066/U+2069 pair, whole token — and the row renders «وحدة الأرشيف Archive» in the correct order (screenshot checked). New test `Partial_Latin_Match_Keeps_The_Whole_Token_In_One_Isolate` asserts one isolate pair and the mark content.

3. Caret anatomy vs A05 (medium) — swapped the two spans so `.w-tree-indent` renders before `.w-tree-caret-slot`; the 20px slot is still reserved on leaf rows. Measured in the host: caret right edge 1050 / 1030 / 1010 for depths 0/1/2 (20px step), icon right edge trails the caret by 8px at every depth, leaf rows at depth 3 put the icon at 962 — exactly one step in from the depth-2 icon at 982, so sibling icons still share a column.
